title: Checkout timeout and retry cascade
question: Why did checkout error rate increase shortly after 10:00 UTC?

hypotheses.label: Payments timeout and retry cascade
hypotheses.description: A shorter downstream timeout plus more retries amplified latency into checkout failures.

hypotheses.label: Primary database saturation
hypotheses.description: Database resource exhaustion caused slow requests and checkout failures.

hypotheses.label: Unexpected traffic spike
hypotheses.description: A sudden increase in request volume exhausted checkout capacity.
